certificate_lifetime.reissue_requires: independent base, binding and semantic evidence checks

context_revisions.reason: Retained explicit native sanity witnesses and evidence-checker CI for the conditional boundary lemma. All full-context obligations remain open.

adequacy.claim: Requirements entailment, input partitions, frame conditions, witnesses and mutation results address specification strength separately.

bindings.claim: Source/compiler/deployed code and mutable proxy, diamond, registry and role bindings match the claimed deployment scope.

calls.claim: Compiler/bytecode call inventory and per-instance resolution reports cover typed, dynamic, library and delegate calls.

models.claim: Each external summary refines the real environment conservatively, including reentrancy, revert and return-data behavior.

results.claim: Exact rule/method instances, call-resolution evidence, sanity results and tool versions are retained; no timeout or skipped instance passes.

roots.claim: All selectors, fallback/receive, constructors, initialization and upgrade transitions are accounted for.

scope.claim: Each functional rule's explored executions are included in the closure proof; filters, bounds and assumptions are justified.

targets.claim: Every possible receiver/selector/code/storage-context tuple is included or soundly modeled; target invariants are inductive.

writers.claim: Every writer of relevant ordinary, namespaced and transient storage, including other facets and callbacks, is covered.

scope_approval.note: Supporting lemmas are partial; no deployment or complete context certificate is issued.

supporting_lemmas.scope: Conditional single-call rejection and boundary effects for three implemented forwarders
